title: GTA 6 Limited Edition DualSense PS5 Controllers Revealed
description: Two limited edition Grand Theft Auto 6 PS5 DualSense controllers were just revealed during the latest Sony State of Play livestream.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Two Limited Edition GTA 6 PS5 DualSense Controllers Revealed

During the recent Sony State of Play livestream, gaming fans received an exciting update regarding Rockstar Games' highly anticipated title: two limited edition Grand Theft Auto 6 PS5 DualSense controllers were officially revealed.

### A Surprise Reveal During State of Play

PlayStation's State of Play broadcasts always draw massive global audiences, and this latest showcase delivered a major surprise for the community. According to reports from Eurogamer, the unveiling of these two limited edition themed controllers marks a significant early look at the physical merchandise tied to the game's broader rollout.

### Expanding the Hardware Ecosystem

Special edition hardware tie-ins have long been a staple for major blockbuster game releases. By introducing custom DualSense controllers featuring a GTA 6 theme, players can anticipate a strong promotional push surrounding the game's hardware ecosystem. While specific details regarding pricing, exact release dates, and pre-order availability were not exhaustively detailed in the initial announcement, the news alone has set gaming forums abuzz with speculation and anticipation.

## Editor's Take

For an eagerly awaited title like GTA 6, hardware reveals are always thrilling milestones. These two limited edition DualSense controllers offer fans an early physical collectible to look forward to, further heightening the excitement as we approach the game's eventual release.
